original.target_description: Original primary paper unavailable; terminal acquisition miss recorded for DOI 10.1016/j.euroecorev.2004.01.004. Replication-paper reproductions are secondary sources and were not substituted.

replication.target_description: Relationship between merit goods and private consumption in past periods (Column 6, Table 5 augmented by disposable income). Same-period reconstruction (1970–1996), difference-GMM country panel, second numeric column; current private-consumption growth is the dependent variable. The 1996–2015 extension is a separate column and is not combined.

n.location: p. 17, Table 8, Observations row, Replication (1970-1996) column; missing-data discussion pp. 6–8
n.sample_role: Country-year observations in the target regression (12-country OECD panel).
n.exclusions: Unbalanced reconstruction due to unavailable historical observations; exact row-level exclusions are not listed. Disposable-income specifications have 225 observations rather than 232.

es.location: p. 17, Table 8, row Δ𝑚 𝑖,𝑡 −1, column Replication (1970-1996)

p.location: p. 17, Table 8, row Δ𝑚 𝑖,𝑡 −1, column Replication (1970-1996); table significance legend
p.quote: Δ𝑚 𝑖,𝑡 −1                      −0.365***                  −0.450***                −0.255** ***=0.01, **=0.05. *=0.10 denote two-sided significance levels.

reported_success.quote: Overall, I interpret my replication as confirming F&K.

notes: Original source has a terminal acquisition miss in the shared cache; no original statistics were taken from Song’s reproduced F&K columns. No target-coefficient test statistic is printed: the table prints regression coefficients and Newey–West standard errors, so the printed coefficient is retained without conversion. The J-test chi-square and p concern instrument validity and are not the target test. P is the printed star-defined significance threshold, not an exact p-value. The paper provides an overall confirmation verdict but no separate narrative success verdict for this lagged-merit/interest-rate test; target-specific reported_success is left null.
